item.name: Super Sonic
item.effect: All players get a large speed boost, much stronger than the standard Speed special.
item.cardSummary: Everyone moves much faster than in a normal or Speed special, so chases and escapes both speed up.

item.name: Upside Down
item.tagline: Now your camera is upside down
item.effect: Player cameras are inverted for the whole round.
item.cardSummary: Your camera flips upside down, so movement and aiming feel reversed until the round ends.

item.name: Reversed Controls
item.effect: Movement controls are reversed for all players.
item.cardSummary: Left becomes right and forward becomes back, so clean inputs matter more than raw speed.

item.name: No Jumping
item.effect: Jumping is disabled for all players.
item.cardSummary: You cannot jump, so ground routes, slides, and usable mobility items matter more than vault paths.

item.name: Speed
item.tagline: Nextbot and player speed has been increased
item.effect: Players move about 1.4x faster with higher acceleration; nextbots also speed up for a faster round.
item.cardSummary: Both survivors and nextbots get faster, turning the round into a high-tempo chase.

item.name: Moon Jump
item.effect: All players receive increased jump power.
item.cardSummary: Higher jumps open vertical routes and short-cuts that are harder to reach in normal rounds.

item.name: Voices
item.effect: Enables broader voice chat so players in the server can communicate more freely.
item.cardSummary: A voice-focused special with limited published mechanical detail beyond open server communication.

item.name: Darkness
item.effect: The map is covered in black fog, cutting visibility. Night Vision is recommended.
item.cardSummary: Black fog hides most of the map, so night-vision tools and sound cues become the main reads.

item.name: Infection
item.tagline: Knocking down will result in a new Nextbot
item.effect: When a nextbot knocks a player down, an additional nextbot appears.
item.cardSummary: Each down can grow the nextbot count, so early downs snowball pressure for the whole lobby.

item.name: Transparent
item.tagline: Nextbots invisible and reveal when approached
item.effect: Nextbots start invisible and only become about 75% visible when near players.
item.cardSummary: Bots stay hard to see until they are close, so radar-style usables help more than line of sight alone.

item.name: Quiet
item.tagline: Nextbots no longer emit idle sounds
item.effect: Nextbots stop playing idle audio but still play kill sounds. Radar and Sensor are recommended.
item.cardSummary: Silent idle bots remove a common audio tell, so sensors and radar replace sound tracking.

item.name: Super Fast Nextbots
item.tagline: The speed of the Nextbots has been increased
item.effect: Nextbots receive about a 1.4x speed boost.
item.cardSummary: Standard nextbots become much faster, punishing slow turns and long open sprints.

item.name: Triple Trouble
item.effect: The number of nextbots is tripled.
item.cardSummary: Three times the normal nextbot count fills the map and closes safe corners quickly.

item.name: Faster Nextbots
item.tagline: The speed of Nextbots has been increased
item.effect: Nextbots receive about a 1.2x speed boost.
item.cardSummary: A lighter nextbot speed-up than Super Fast Nextbots, still making chases harder to reset.

item.name: Double Trouble
item.effect: The number of nextbots is doubled.
item.cardSummary: Twice as many nextbots as a normal round, so space dries up faster across the map.

item.name: Tiny Nextbots
item.effect: All nextbots are half their normal size.
item.cardSummary: Smaller hitboxes and silhouettes make bots harder to track at range and in clutter.

item.name: Big Nextbots
item.effect: All nextbots are twice their normal size.
item.cardSummary: Oversized nextbots are easier to spot but cover more space and block routes more aggressively.

item.name: Huge Nextbots
item.effect: All nextbots are three times their normal size.
item.cardSummary: Extremely large nextbots dominate sightlines and pathways while remaining easy to see.

item.name: Plushie Hell
item.tagline: This is what you get when you don't spend on the plushies
item.effect: Floods the map with CatJard and Wolf Rebel, among the fastest nextbots in the game.
item.spawnNotes: About 5–6 on normal servers and 6–8 on large servers
item.cardSummary: A top-reward special that fills the map with two of the fastest nextbots, leaving little room to camp.

item.name: Cat Jard
item.effect: Spawns only CatJard, described as one of the fastest nextbots.
item.cardSummary: A pure CatJard swarm focused on raw speed pressure rather than mixed bot variety.

item.name: Lurking
item.effect: Spawns Super Munci packs; Super Munci is faster than Angry Munci.
item.cardSummary: Similar structure to Angry Munci, but Super Munci packs raise the pace and the reward.

item.name: Steam Happi Swarm
item.effect: Like Steam Happi, but with a larger Steam Happi count.
item.spawnNotes: Higher count than the base Steam Happi special
item.cardSummary: A denser Steam Happi flood than the base special, trading open space for higher rewards.

item.name: Angry Bobo
item.effect: Spawns Angry Bobo R6 packs with a small speed boost (about 1.1x).
item.spawnNotes: About 4–5 on normal servers and 6–8 on large servers
item.cardSummary: Angry Bobo packs push harder than standard Bobo floods and pay a higher multiplier.

item.name: Bunny Party
item.effect: Spawns Bunny Bobo, Bunny Jard, and Bunny Galf.
item.featuredNextbots: Bunny Bobo, Bunny Jard, Bunny Galf
item.spawnNotes: About 6–9 on normal servers and 9–12 on large servers
item.cardSummary: A themed multi-bot bunny swarm that packs the map with several related nextbots.

item.name: Cat Party
item.effect: Spawns Kitten Jard and Kitten Bobo packs.
item.spawnNotes: About 6–8 on normal servers and 9–10 on large servers
item.cardSummary: A kitten-themed double swarm that overloads space with small fast nextbots.

item.name: Steam Happi
item.effect: Spawns Steam Happi packs with a small movement speed boost.
item.spawnNotes: About 5–6 on normal servers and 6–8 on large servers
item.cardSummary: A mid-reward Steam Happi flood before the denser Swarm variant.

item.name: Survive Bobo Classic
item.effect: Spawns classic Bobo packs with about a 1.2x speed boost; older Survive Bobo style from before Overhaul.
item.spawnNotes: About 6–7 on normal servers and 8–12 on large servers
item.cardSummary: The pre-Overhaul Bobo flood with slightly different counts and the classic Bobo form.

item.name: Incursion
item.effect: Spawns Rebel packs that open fire when players enter their line of sight.
item.spawnNotes: About 4–5 on normal servers and 6–8 on large servers
item.cardSummary: Rebels punish exposed angles, so staying out of sightlines matters as much as pure running.

item.name: Survive Bobo
item.tagline: He gave you one last chance
item.effect: Spawns Bobo R6 packs with a small speed boost.
item.spawnNotes: About 5–6 on normal servers and 8–16 on large servers
item.cardSummary: A large Bobo R6 swarm that forces constant repositioning instead of long camps.

item.name: Survive Jard
item.tagline: Don't underestimate the power of a bachelor's degree
item.effect: Spawns Jard R6 packs with a small speed boost.
item.spawnNotes: About 5–7 on normal servers and 7–8 on large servers
item.cardSummary: A Jard-focused flood that fills routes with several boosted Jards at once.

item.name: Hard Difficulty
item.effect: Spawns Hard Difficulty and Normal Difficulty nextbots, with Hard Difficulty slightly sped up.
item.spawnNotes: About 5–6 total on normal servers and 7–8 on large servers
item.cardSummary: Mixes hard and normal difficulty nextbots so the pack is denser and meaner than a standard spawn.

item.name: Mimic
item.tagline: Keep an eye on your teammates
item.effect: Spawns Mimic nextbots that take a random player form while chasing others.
item.spawnNotes: About 4–6 on normal servers and 6–8 on large servers
item.cardSummary: Mimics look like players, so friend-shaped chasers can punish careless grouping.

item.name: Angry Munci
item.effect: Spawns Angry Munci packs; very fast and hard to outrun in the open.
item.cardSummary: A low-count but high-pressure special where hiding and smart pathing beat pure sprinting.

item.name: 3D Rampage
item.effect: Spawns a mixed 3D nextbot cast including Angry Bobo R6, Baldi, Defect, Eyeless, Fazbore, Pac Man, Rebel, Slasher, Triple T, and Trollge.
item.featuredNextbots: Angry Bobo R6, Baldi, Defect, Eyeless, Fazbore, Pac Man, Rebel, Slasher, Triple T, Trollge
item.cardSummary: A mixed 3D cast special that throws many named models into one high-chaos chase.

item.name: Baldi's Basics
item.effect: Spawns Baldi nextbots as the featured threat.
item.cardSummary: A Baldi spotlight special focused on that nextbot instead of the normal random pool.

item.name: Damnation
item.effect: Spawns both Gubby and Slasher while covering the map in darkness.
item.cardSummary: Combines Gubby and Slasher pressure with dark fog, stacking two dangerous threat types.

item.name: Defect
item.effect: Spawns Defect nextbots as the featured threat.
item.cardSummary: A Defect spotlight special that replaces the usual mix with that nextbot.

item.name: Oswald
item.effect: Spawns several Oswald nextbots.
item.cardSummary: An Oswald-focused special with limited published multiplier and spawn-count detail.

item.name: Survive The Gubbies
item.tagline: This is so retro like release the gubbies
item.effect: Spawns Gubby packs that can jump high while chasing players.
item.cardSummary: A Gubby swarm special where high jumps make vertical camps less safe.

item.name: The Eyeless
item.tagline: Be quiet and don't steal its block
item.effect: Spawns Eyeless nextbots as the featured threat.
item.cardSummary: An Eyeless spotlight special; published detail is mostly the featured bot and tagline.

item.name: The Spectre's Wish
item.tagline: The Slasher has arrived. Deaths are permanent
item.effect: Spawns Slasher chasers and covers the map in darkness. Sources note deaths as permanent in this special.
item.cardSummary: Slashers hunt through dark fog, and downs are treated as permanent for this special.

item.name: Triple Tung Rampage
item.tagline: It's 3 tungs, no more, no less
item.effect: Spawns Triple T nextbots as the featured threat.
item.cardSummary: A Triple T spotlight special focused on that nextbot family.

item.name: Trollge
item.tagline: Hey, you might know me already
item.effect: Spawns Trollge nextbots as the featured threat.
item.cardSummary: A Trollge spotlight special with limited published multiplier detail.
